changes.title: Notices
changes.oldText: All notices shall be sent to CloudDesk at Level 4, 12 MG Road, Bengaluru 560001.
changes.newText: All notices shall be sent to CloudDesk at Tower B, 7th Floor, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru 560103.
changes.plain: CloudDesk's office address for legal notices has changed.

changes.title: Definitions
changes.oldText: "effective date" means the date on which this Agreement is signed by both parties.
changes.newText: "Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement is signed by both parties.
changes.plain: A defined term is now capitalised. The meaning doesn't change.

changes.title: Limitation of liability
changes.oldText: Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.
changes.newText: Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the six (6) months before the claim.
changes.plain: Today, either side's liability is capped at 12 months of fees. CloudDesk wants to halve that to 6 months.

changes.title: Renewal
changes.oldText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives thirty (30) days' written notice.
changes.newText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives ninety (90) days' written notice.
changes.plain: Today, you can stop the auto-renewal with 30 days' notice. CloudDesk wants 90 days, so you'd have to decide three months before the end.

changes.title: Service credits
changes.oldText: Service credits are applied automatically to the next invoice.
changes.newText: Service credits are payable only if Customer submits a written claim within ten (10) days of the end of the month in which the failure occurred.
changes.plain: Today, CloudDesk credits your next invoice automatically. Under the proposal, your team must submit a written claim within 10 days.

changes.title: Fees
changes.oldText: The Fees are fixed for the Initial Term and any Renewal Term.
changes.newText: Supplier may revise the Fees once in each contract year by written notice.
changes.plain: Today, the fees are fixed for the term. CloudDesk wants to be able to raise them once a year, with no cap.

changes.title: Notices
changes.oldText: Notices to SwiftShip shall be sent to legal@swiftship.example.
changes.newText: Notices to SwiftShip shall be sent to contracts@swiftship.example.
changes.plain: SwiftShip's email address for legal notices has changed.

changes.title: Renewal
changes.oldText: This Agreement renews only if Customer confirms in writing before the end of the Term.
changes.newText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives ninety (90) days' written notice.
changes.plain: Today, the contract renews only if you say yes. SwiftShip wants it to renew automatically unless you give 90 days' notice.

changes.title: Service credits
changes.oldText: Service credits are payable if Customer submits a written claim within fifteen (15) days of the end of the month in which the failure occurred.
changes.newText: Service credits are payable only if Customer submits a written claim within seven (7) days of the end of the month in which the failure occurred.
changes.plain: Today, you have 15 days to claim service credits. SwiftShip wants to cut that to 7 days.

changes.title: Definitions
changes.oldText: "business day" means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Bengaluru.
changes.newText: "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Bengaluru.
changes.plain: A defined term is now capitalised. The meaning doesn't change.

changes.title: Notices
changes.oldText: Notices to Nimbus shall be sent to 3rd Floor, Prestige Tech Park, Bengaluru.
changes.newText: Notices to Nimbus shall be sent to 9th Floor, Embassy Tech Village, Bengaluru.
changes.plain: Nimbus's office address for legal notices has changed.

changes.title: Heading
changes.oldText: Scehdule 2: Service Levels
changes.newText: Schedule 2: Service Levels
changes.plain: A typo in a schedule heading is fixed.

changes.title: Indemnity
changes.oldText: Supplier shall indemnify Customer against all third-party claims that the Service infringes intellectual property rights.
changes.newText: Supplier shall indemnify Customer against third-party claims that the Service infringes intellectual property rights, up to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.
changes.plain: Today, Nimbus's intellectual-property indemnity has no cap. Nimbus wants to cap it at 12 months of fees.

changes.title: Fees
changes.oldText: Supplier may revise the Fees once in each contract year by written notice.
changes.newText: Supplier may revise the Fees once in each contract year by written notice, and once more in any year in which its third-party hosting costs increase.
changes.plain: Today, Nimbus can raise fees once a year with no cap. Nimbus wants a second rise in any year its hosting costs go up.

changes.title: Recitals
changes.oldText: The Customer wishes to engage the Supplier to provide contract personel.
changes.newText: The Customer wishes to engage the Supplier to provide contract personnel.
changes.plain: A spelling mistake in the recitals is fixed.

changes.title: Definitions
changes.oldText: "contractor personnel" means individuals supplied by Supplier under this Agreement.
changes.newText: "Contractor Personnel" means individuals supplied by Supplier under this Agreement.
changes.plain: A defined term is now capitalised. The meaning doesn't change.

changes.title: Non-solicitation
changes.oldText: Customer shall not directly hire Contractor Personnel during the Term and for six (6) months after it.
changes.newText: Customer shall not directly hire Contractor Personnel during the Term and for twenty-four (24) months after it.
changes.plain: Today, you can't hire BrightStaff's people for 6 months after the contract ends. BrightStaff wants 24 months.

changes.title: Renewal
changes.oldText: This Agreement renews only if Customer confirms in writing before the end of the Term.
changes.newText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives sixty (60) days' written notice.
changes.plain: Today, the contract renews only if you say yes. BrightStaff wants it to renew automatically unless you give 60 days' notice.

changes.title: Fees
changes.oldText: The rates in Schedule 1 are fixed for the Term.
changes.newText: Supplier may revise the rates in Schedule 1 once in each contract year by written notice.
changes.plain: Today, the rates are fixed for the term. BrightStaff wants to be able to raise them once a year, with no cap.

changes.title: Sites
changes.oldText: Site 2: Plot 14, Whitefield Main Road, Bengaluru.
changes.newText: Site 2: Plot 14A, Whitefield Main Road, Bengaluru.
changes.plain: A site's plot number is corrected.

changes.newText: Supplier's account manager is Lata Menon.

changes.title: Services

changes.newText: The Supplier shall provide housekeeping services at each Site.
changes.plain: A spelling mistake in the services clause is fixed.

changes.title: Numbering
changes.oldText: 10.5 Insurance
changes.newText: 10.4 Insurance
changes.plain: A clause is renumbered.

changes.title: Renewal
changes.oldText: This Agreement renews automatically unless either party gives thirty (30) days' written notice.
changes.newText: This Agreement renews automatically unless either party gives ninety (90) days' written notice.
changes.plain: Today, you can stop the auto-renewal with 30 days' notice. CleanCo wants 90 days.

changes.title: Data breach notice
changes.oldText: Supplier shall notify Customer of any personal data breach within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of it.
changes.newText: Supplier shall notify Customer of any personal data breach within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.
changes.plain: Today, DataVault must tell you about a personal-data breach within 24 hours. DataVault wants 72 hours.

changes.title: Governing law
changes.oldText: This Agreement is governed by the laws of India, and the courts of Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction.
changes.newText: This Agreement is governed by the laws of Singapore, and disputes shall be finally resolved by arbitration under the SIAC Rules.
changes.plain: Today, Indian law applies and disputes go to Bengaluru courts. DataVault wants Singapore law and arbitration.
